target_customer: Managed service providers and IT teams that resell or run robotic process automation for small and mid-size businesses
problem: Enterprise RPA from UiPath and Automation Anywhere is expensive and complex for small businesses and the service providers that serve them.
business_model: B2B software licenses and subscriptions sold through managed service providers and channel partners, plus a marketplace presence
product_category: Robotic process automation and document processing

founders.name: Sergey Yudovskiy
previous_startups: Earlier YC company (named as 2x YC founder on the YC page; outcome not stated)
founders.background_notes: YC page calls him a mathematician and a 2x YC founder who scaled ElectroNeek to about $5M ARR, and says he now builds Adentris.

competitors.name: UiPath
competitors.what: Market leading enterprise RPA platform; ElectroNeek's own site names it as a platform customers switch from
competitors.funding_then: $568M Series D led by Coatue, announced 2019-04-30, bringing total above $1B

technical_complexity.rationale: Building a bot designer, orchestrator and later document processing is standard enterprise software with some hard integration work against legacy systems.

defensibility.rationale: Bots built on a platform and an MSP channel create some lock-in, but incumbents and free tools offered similar capabilities.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents were well funded and moved down market; ElectroNeek still reached a $20M Series A in 2021 and later reorganized, per its own press release.

market_need_then: RPA was a fast growing category in 2019 with UiPath at a $7B valuation, and smaller service providers lacked affordable tooling.

branding.domain_note: Uses electroneek.com; acquisition history not found.

identity.logo: Green primary mark with charcoal secondary per the company brand book
identity.visual_style: Montserrat typeface and green palette per the brand book
identity.voice_and_tone: Values listed as innovation not status quo, visionary not market standard, ownership not temporary

brand_strength.rationale: Only a company brand book and partner press releases were found; no independent coverage of the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: ElectroNeek raised a $20M Series A in mid 2021 at a reported $105M post-money valuation and grew through a managed service provider channel, reaching about 175 staff per the YC page. Its own press release later describes cutting headcount in non-R&D roles after reorganizing the RPA platform, which signals a squeeze from incumbents. It remains active with no acquisition found.
notes: Seed: Seedtable and a 645 Ventures page both list $2.5M around March 2020; FinSMEs reports a $500K pre-seed for a New York based startup, so the amounts conflict and the FinSMEs figure is unverified. The 645 Ventures page was not opened, only its search listing. The $105M valuation comes from the company blog snippet in search results. The YC page dates the Series A to January 2021 but outlets date it June 2021. Co-founders besides Yudovskiy were not found in sources opened. The leadership and reorganization press release is undated in my reading. Automation Anywhere is also an incumbent but no dated source was verified so it is not listed. Total raised about $23M per CB Insights (aggregator).
